titlePlain: Lab: Writing a Correlation Rule for a Known
subtitle: Lesson 30 · Capstone: A Day in the SOC

steps.label: Trigger
steps.sub: any successful authentication, from every sign-in source

steps.label: Group & window
steps.sub: same user_id, two or more countries inside 60 minutes

steps.label: Calculate
steps.sub: required travel speed, not a fixed list of countries

code:
WHEN event_type = "successful_authentication"
GROUP BY user_id WITHIN 60 minutes
  COUNT(DISTINCT geo_country) >= 2
  AND required_speed(loc_1, loc_2, time_1, time_2) > 500 mph
THEN RAISE ALERT "Impossible Travel Detected" severity=high
caption: Chicago to Hanoi in 39 minutes clears 500 mph easily - Lesson 29's Alert C, exactly.

titlePlain: The SOC's Own VPN Would Trip

steps.label: The problem
steps.sub: VPN exit nodes can land in a different country than the employee

steps.label: The fix
steps.sub: exception list for known corporate exit-node ranges

steps.label: Not a full suppress
steps.sub: lower severity, still reviewable, never silently dropped

code:
IF loc_1 OR loc_2 IN known_vpn_exit_ranges:
  severity = "low"   // reviewed, not suppressed
ELSE:
  severity = "high"  // Lesson 29's Alert C, unchanged
caption: Known VPN exits get a lower severity, not a free pass.
